Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 1, 2026

Welcome to the privacy policy of WearOBD. WearOBD is a standalone Wear OS application that connects to compatible Bluetooth OBD-II adapters and displays vehicle information on your watch.

1. Information We Do Not Collect

WearOBD does not collect, sell, or share personal information. We do not create user profiles, track your location, or monitor your driving activity. The app does not use advertising trackers, analytics services, or third-party monitoring services.

2. Vehicle and Diagnostic Data

Vehicle data received from your OBD-II adapter, including speed, RPM, temperatures, fuel information, electric vehicle readings, VIN, diagnostic trouble codes, emissions readiness status, and supported protocol information, is used only to provide the features you request. This data is processed locally on your Wear OS device and is not sent to us or stored on our servers.

3. Performance and Trip Data

Trip distance, estimated fuel consumption, acceleration timing results, rolling speed test results, and session best times are used to display the app's dashboard and performance features. These values remain on your device unless you choose to share or export them using a system feature or another app.

4. Bluetooth Connections

WearOBD uses Bluetooth Classic and Bluetooth Low Energy, where supported, to discover and communicate directly with your compatible OBD-II adapter. Bluetooth data is exchanged only with the adapter you select. WearOBD does not operate a relay, proxy, or cloud service that receives or stores this data.

5. Permissions

The app requests Bluetooth permissions required to discover, connect to, and communicate with OBD-II adapters. Any nearby-device permission is used only for this Bluetooth functionality. The app does not request or use background location access to track you.

6. Data Retention and Deletion

WearOBD does not retain your vehicle or diagnostic data on external systems. You can remove locally stored app data by clearing the app's storage or uninstalling the app through your Wear OS device settings.

7. Third-Party Services

WearOBD does not send vehicle data, diagnostic information, or performance results to third parties. Your use of any system sharing or export feature is governed by the privacy policy of the destination app or service you choose.

8. Safety Notice

WearOBD is intended for use when the vehicle is stationary or by a passenger. Always follow local traffic laws and use performance timing only in a safe, controlled area. Adapter compatibility and available readings depend on your vehicle, ECU, and OBD-II adapter.

9. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page.
